details: Banyan builds static output and generates delivery rules. Swaw Clouds guides account authorization, cloud project setup and publication through native platform tools.
Choose cloudflare or edgeone, then upload for built output or git for platform builds. These guides do not publish.
Other static hosts, object stores and CDNs can serve the output; configure their headers, redirects and caching separately.
Banyan 构建静态产物并生成交付规则；Swaw Clouds 指导账号授权、云项目配置和原生工具发布。
选择 cloudflare 或 edgeone，再选择 upload（上传产物）或 git（平台构建）。这些入口提供说明，不执行发布。
其他静态托管、对象存储和 CDN 也可承载产物；响应头、重定向及缓存需按目标平台另行配置。
